component.name: Scrcpy GUI
component.summary: A simple, modern desktop interface for scrcpy

description.p: Scrcpy GUI discovers Android devices over USB or wireless debugging and launches scrcpy with a reliable, visual configuration. It supports several devices at once, recording, audio, modern keyboard modes, cropping, window placement, and the current scrcpy 4.x command line.

ul.li: Automatic USB discovery, Android 11+ wireless pairing, and legacy TCP/IP connections
Simultaneous multi-device launch with named profiles and device groups
Recording, audio forwarding, and modern SDK/UHID/AOA keyboard modes
Verified official scrcpy and adb bundled with the release, no PATH setup required

description.p: See the upstream changelog for details.
